mapper.select: SELECT * FROM generation_result WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY position
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generation_result WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generation_result WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND state = #{state}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM generation_result WHERE state = #{state}

SELECT r.*, t.user_id AS user_id, t.state AS task_state, t.output_count AS task_output_count FROM generation_result r JOIN generation_task t ON t.id = r.task_id WHERE t.accounting_state = 'FROZEN' AND t.state IN ('RESULT_PENDING','REVIEW') AND ( (r.state = 'PENDING' AND (r.next_attempt_at IS NULL OR r.next_attempt_at <= NOW(3))) OR (r.state = 'SAVING' AND (r.lease_until IS NULL OR r.lease_until < NOW(3))) ) ORDER BY r.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_result SET state = 'SAVING', owner = #{owner}, lease_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), generation = generation + 1, save_attempts = save_attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND ( (state = 'PENDING' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= NOW(3))) OR (state = 'SAVING' AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < NOW(3))) )

UPDATE generation_result r JOIN media_asset m ON m.id = #{mediaId} SET r.state = 'SAVED', r.media_id = #{mediaId}, r.content_digest = #{contentDigest}, r.content_type = #{contentType}, r.size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, r.saved_at = NOW(3), r.owner = NULL, r.lease_until = NULL, r.next_attempt_at = NULL, r.last_error = NULL WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.owner = #{owner} AND r.generation = #{generation} AND r.state = 'SAVING' AND m.state = 'ACTIVE' AND m.source = 'GENERATED'

UPDATE generation_result SET state = IF(#{finalFailure}, 'FAILED', 'PENDING'), next_attempt_at = IF(#{finalFailure}, NULL, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND)), last_error = #{error}, owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND owner = #{owner} AND generation = #{generation} AND state = 'SAVING'
UPDATE generation_result SET state = 'DELIVERED', delivered_at = NOW(3) WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND state = 'SAVED'
UPDATE generation_result SET state = 'PENDING', save_attempts = 0, next_attempt_at = NOW(3), owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error = NULL WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND state = 'FAILED'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_asset m WHERE m.source = 'GENERATED' AND m.state = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_result r WHERE r.media_id = m.id) AND m.created_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{graceSeconds} SECOND)

SELECT m.id FROM media_asset m WHERE m.source = 'GENERATED' AND m.state = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_result r WHERE r.media_id = m.id) AND m.created_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{graceSeconds} SECOND) ORDER BY m.id LIMIT #{limit}
